## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

H3 removes the usual task boundaries between generation modes. Text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-frame control, and reference-driven generation (character, motion, camera, voice, style) are all handled by one model instead of separate expert pipelines.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

```text
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>是@图片1中的夏萱，20岁左右的中国年轻女子，身形纤细但富有活力。她机灵、怕死却心地善良；紧张时眼神飘忽、嘴唇微抿，关键时刻眼神坚定、动作果断。完整保留@图片1中的面容、发型、服装和整体造型。
<Subject 2>是@图片2中的柳浮生，外表温雅有礼，笑容清浅，举止端方；眼神深处冷静疏离，始终像在观察和试探身边的人。完整保留@图片2中的面容、发型、服装，以及随身佩戴的青色剑。
<Subject 3>是@图片3中的废宅地窖，空间阴暗潮湿，地面铺有凌乱干草，整体呈灰绿色冷调，顶部木板缝隙漏下狭窄的冷白光束。

summary:
[reference generation] 生成一段15秒的16:9横向画幅的高精度半写实3D国漫短剧片段。<Subject 1>背着受伤的<Subject 2>踉跄进入<Subject 3>，将他安置在干草上并查看伤势。她准备收回手时，原本昏迷的柳浮生突然抓住她的手腕，睁眼试探她。

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>（出现在[Shot 1]至[Shot 5]）：fully_preserved - 完整保留夏萱在@图片1中的人物身份、面容、发型、服装和身形，并呈现她疲惫、紧张、心虚和怕死却善良的性格。
<Subject 2>（出现在[Shot 1]至[Shot 5]）：fully_preserved - 完整保留柳浮生在@图片2中的人物身份、面容、发型、服装、青色剑，以及温和表象下冷静锐利的眼神。
<Subject 3>（贯穿全部镜头）：fully_preserved - 完整保留@图片3中废宅地窖的空间结构、潮湿质感、凌乱干草、灰绿冷调和顶部冷白漏光。

detailed_description:
全片采用真人电影质感的中国古装悬疑风格，冷灰绿色调，低照度、高反差布光，浅景深，人物表演克制自然。严格保持两名角色在各镜头中的面容、发型、服装和配饰一致。

[Shot 1] 地窖中景。画面展现<Subject 3>，废宅地窖阴暗潮湿，空气中漂浮着细小灰尘，顶部腐朽木板的缝隙漏下几束冷白光，地面散落凌乱干草。<Subject 1>夏萱背着受伤虚弱的<Subject 2>柳浮生踉跄进入画面。她脚步沉重不稳，身体左右摇晃，肩膀因负重微微颤抖，呼吸急促。柳浮生双眼紧闭，无力地伏在她背上，@图片2中的青色剑佩戴在身侧，随着步伐轻微晃动。夏萱艰难蹲下，把柳浮生小心安置在干草上，自己险些失去平衡。她累得喘不过气，却没有休息，立即蹲在他身旁查看伤势。<Subject 1>（S1）喘息着低声说道：<d>[Chinese] 这里暂时安全了。</d>

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000，镜头切至夏萱近景。冷白光照亮她沾着灰尘和汗水的脸，几缕头发贴在额角；柳浮生躺在后方阴影中的干草上，身体虚化，青色剑仍可隐约辨认。夏萱眉头紧锁，眼神带着担忧和不安。她俯下身体，将手背轻轻贴上柳浮生的额头，确认他是否发热。<Subject 1>（S1）用紧张、急促而压低的声音小声说道：<d>[Chinese] 你可千万别死，我还指望你带我出去呢。</d> 说话时她视线飘忽，嘴唇微抿，像是在掩饰自己的真实担忧。

[Shot 3] At 00:07.000，镜头突然切至手腕超近特写。夏萱确认完体温，手掌刚要从柳浮生额前收回。就在她的手腕经过明暗交界处时，一只冷白、修长的手突然从阴影中伸出，准确抓住她的手腕。柳浮生的动作迅速、精准，力道并不粗暴，却带着不容挣脱的控制感。夏萱的手瞬间停在半空，手指猛然绷紧，衣袖发出短促的摩擦声。抓住手腕的一瞬间，沉重而清晰的心跳声突然加重。

[Shot 4] At 00:10.000，镜头切至双人近距离特写，并以小幅度缓慢向前推进。<Subject 2>柳浮生半张脸隐藏在阴影里，<Subject 1>夏萱则处于冷白光中，两人的脸距离很近。柳浮生缓慢睁开双眼，唇边仍保留温和有礼的浅笑，漆黑眼睛却没有丝毫昏沉，目光完全清醒、冷静而锐利，像在审视夏萱的每一个细微反应。夏萱明显僵住，肩膀停止动作，连呼吸都短暂停顿。<Subject 2>（S2）用温和从容、略带试探的低沉男声说道：<d>[Chinese] 夏姑娘，你似乎很怕我死。</d>

[Shot 5] At 00:13.000，镜头切至夏萱面部极近特写。背景完全虚化，冷白光集中在她的眼睛上。听见柳浮生的话后，她的瞳孔迅速收缩，眼神心虚地向旁边闪躲，不敢与他对视。她抿紧嘴唇，手臂向后用力，试图抽回被抓住的手腕，却没有成功。画面边缘仍能看见柳浮生稳定不动的手指。<Subject 1>（S1）慌乱地结巴道：<d>[Chinese] 我……我只是……</d> 她的声音越来越轻，未说完的话悬停在最后一帧。

overall_soundscape:
地窖内持续回荡低沉空旷的环境声，伴随远处滴水、腐朽木板轻微吱响和干草摩擦声。开场突出夏萱踉跄的脚步、衣料摩擦、青色剑轻微碰撞以及急促喘息。00:07.000抓住手腕的瞬间，其他环境声短暂压低，沉重心跳声突然增强并持续至结尾。

non_diegetic_music:
N/A
```

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the silver-haired older man in a blue shirt and jeans, defined by the multi-view character sheet <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> is the spacious modern airport terminal lobby with large glass windows and sunset light, defined by <Picture 2>.
<Subject 3> is the same silver-haired man wearing an ornate black gothic noble outfit with a red cravat and cape, holding a cane, defined by the multi-view character sheet <Picture 3>.
<Subject 4> is the elegant mansion estate garden with a cobblestone driveway at sunset, defined by <Picture 4>.

summary:
[reference generation] A cinematic 10-second transformation video showing a man changing from casual attire in an airport to a gothic noble outfit at a mansion estate via a fiery transition.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - The casual appearance, face, and hair of the older man are accurately rendered.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - The airport terminal background matches the architecture and warm sunset lighting of the reference.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - The gothic noble outfit, cape, cane, and facial features are precisely maintained.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - The luxurious mansion facade, cobblestone path, and warm sunset atmosphere are faithfully reproduced.

detailed_description:
The video features a dramatic, high-contrast fantasy transformation style with rich, warm color grading.
[Shot 1] The video opens with <Subject 1> standing in the middle of the airport terminal lobby of <Subject 2>. The warm sunset glows through the windows. <Subject 1> dynamically sweeps his arm across the frame. This motion conjures a sudden burst of brilliant golden sparks and roaring flames mingled with swirling orange leaves. The fiery explosion quickly expands, completely covering the screen in a dazzling orange-gold wipe transition.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the dense flames and light effects rapidly disperse to reveal <Subject 3> standing elegantly on the wet cobblestone driveway of <Subject 4>. He holds his silver-topped cane, looking forward with a calm, powerful gaze. Bright sunlight streams through the trees behind him, creating a strong Tyndall effect with visible light beams. The deep black of his noble outfit contrasts sharply with the rich, golden-orange autumn leaves and sunset sky of the mansion estate.

overall_soundscape:
A loud, rushing swoosh accompanies the arm sweep, followed by a powerful, crackling explosion of flames that peaks and fades into the gentle rustling of leaves and wind in a quiet garden.

non_diegetic_music:
A dramatic orchestral build-up with swelling brass and percussion that reaches a climax during the transition, resolving into a sophisticated, mysterious violin solo.
